mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.created_at, p.city, p.job_status AS jobStatus, p.desired_job AS desiredJob, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume r WHERE r.candidate_id = u.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) AS resumeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume_application ra WHERE ra.candidate_id = u.id) AS applyCount FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'CANDIDATE'
AND u.status = #{status}
AND (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC

SELECT city, job_status AS jobStatus, desired_job AS desiredJob, desired_city AS desiredCity, desired_salary_min AS desiredSalaryMin, desired_salary_max AS desiredSalaryMax FROM sys_user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume WHERE candidate_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume_application WHERE candidate_id = #{userId}

SELECT ra.id, jp.title AS jobTitle, hc.name AS companyName, ra.status, ra.submitted_at AS appliedAt, ra.updated_at AS lastUpdatedAt FROM resume_application ra LEFT JOIN job_post jp ON ra.job_id = jp.id LEFT JOIN hr_company hc ON jp.company_id = hc.id WHERE ra.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY ra.submitted_at DESC
